parts.text: Name the two types of blood vessel shown by **X** and **Y** in Fig. 3.1.

parts.label: (a)(ii)

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: Tissue fluid and lymph are formed when blood arrives in the capillary networks of body tissues.
parts.text: Explain why tissue fluid is more similar to blood plasma than it is to blood.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why the tissue fluid formed after blood arrives in the capillary network has a **higher** concentration of amino acids than the newly formed lymph draining away from the network.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The trachea, bronchi and bronchioles in the gas exchange system require a supply of glucose and oxygen from the blood for the functioning of smooth muscle.

Outline the function of smooth muscle in the gas exchange system.
